_readme: Starting set of sources for working-student / internship roles in Germany.
Copy to config/boards.json, edit, then: node scripts/seed-boards.ts
Every entry here was fetched live and measured. 'total' is what the source
returned; 'match' is how many survived config/filters.example.json. Those
numbers are a snapshot from the date below, not a promise -- boards move.
The headline finding: the Bundesagentur searches massively outperform
company boards for this particular goal. One city search returns more
student roles than the entire Bosch board, which is 4727 postings deep.
Company boards are worth keeping for employers you specifically care about,
not as a way to find volume.

boards.note: 465 total, 121 matched - best single source measured
4727 total, 48 matched. Highest absolute yield of any company board, but it is also the most expensive source here: ~48 API requests every cycle. Drop it first if you want the poll cheap.
32 total, 8 matched - best signal-to-noise ratio of any company board
56 total, 0 matched at time of measurement - board is live, just had no student roles open

_checked_and_unavailable: These were tried and do NOT work, recorded so nobody re-checks them:
smartrecruiters: SAP, Siemens, Zalando, HelloFresh, TeamViewer, Infineon, N26, Personio, Celonis, Trivago, FlixBus, Bosch (the working slug is 'BoschGroup')
lever: blinkist, adjust, omio, sennder, cargoone
personio: staffbase, sennder, forto, choco, tier, isar-aerospace, enpal, gorillas, 1komma5 (no public search.json tenant)
A slug that answers with an empty or error body is not always a 404 -- Lever
returns HTTP 200 with {ok:false}, which is why /watch fetches before it
